title.narrative: 2025 Voluntary contributio to UNIDROIT for "Zambia Alternative Dispute Resolution Mechanism for Sustainable Trade and Investment 2026
Contributo volontario 2025 a UNIDROIT per lo "Zambia Alternative Dispute Resolution Mechanism for Sustainable Trade and Investment 2026

description.narrative: Il progetto Zambia Alternative Dispute Resolution Mechanism for Sustainable Trade and Investment 2026 dell’UNIDROIT comprende un programma di formazione di 10 mesi, svolto in parte in presenza (in Zambia e in Italia) e in parte online, rivolto a funzionari pubblici, giudici ed esperti legali sui meccanismi di risoluzione alternativa delle controversie (ADR). L’obiettivo è fornire una formazione sia teorica che pratica, includendo la giurisprudenza pertinente e i principi del diritto commerciale internazionale, per sostenere la prevenzione e la risoluzione delle controversie. Il lavoro dell’UNIDROIT attraverso l’iniziativa Zambia Alternative Dispute Resolution Mechanism for Sustainable Trade and Investment 2026 ha un impatto trasversale sull’attuazione dell’Agenda 2030 e incide in modo primario sull’Obiettivo di Sviluppo Sostenibile n. 16 (Pace, giustizia e istituzioni solide), rafforzando la capacità del paese partner di garantire sistemi giudiziari efficaci, trasparenti e accessibili. Il progetto contribuisce inoltre trasversalmente all’Obiettivo n. 17 (Partnership per gli obiettivi), promuovendo la cooperazione internazionale e le reti tra portatori di interesse italiani e africani, e all’Obiettivo n. 8 (Lavoro dignitoso e crescita economica), favorendo un ambiente imprenditoriale stabile e sostenibile che supporti gli investimenti e lo sviluppo economico.

The UNIDROIT’s “Zambia Alternative Dispute Resolution Mechanism for Sustainable Trade and Investment 2026” by UNIDROIT includes a 10-month training programme, conducted partly in person (in Zambia and Italy) and partly online, targeting public officials, judges, and legal experts on alternative dispute resolution (ADR) mechanisms. The objective is to provide both theoretical and practical training, including relevant case law and principles of international commercial law, to support the prevention and resolution of disputes. UNIDROIT’s work through the initiative “Zambia Alternative Dispute Resolution Mechanism for Sustainable Trade and Investment 2026” has a cross-cutting impact on the implementation of the 2030 Agenda and has a primary impact on Sustainable Development Goal 16 (Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions), by strengthening the partner country’s capacity to ensure effective, transparent, and accessible judicial systems. The project also contributes transversally to SDG 17 (Partnerships for the Goals), by fostering international cooperation and networks between Italian and African stakeholders, and to SDG 8 (Decent Work and Economic Growth), by promoting a stable and sustainable business environment that supports investment and economic development.
